goal: Deliver a multilingual e-commerce MVP with admin panel, card payments, inventory, authentication, automated tests and a preview deployment, ending in a reviewable pull request.

stack.name: Next.js
stack.justification: One deployable unit for web + API keeps the MVP simple and matches the modular-monolith decision.

stack.name: PostgreSQL
stack.justification: Relational model fits catalog + orders + inventory; row-level security supports multi-tenant admin.

stack.name: Prisma
stack.justification: Typed schema gives the coding agent a machine-checkable data model and reversible migrations.

stack.name: Stripe (adapter behind interface)
stack.justification: Wrapped behind a PaymentProvider interface so the provider can be swapped without touching checkout code.

stack.name: Playwright
stack.justification: Covers checkout happy path plus keyboard-only navigation checks.

milestones.name: Bootstrap
exitCriteria: CI workflow runs green on the agent branch

milestones.name: Auth and multi-tenancy
exitCriteria: Login and logout covered by tests
Cross-tenant access attempt returns 403 in a test

tasks.title: Analyse the target repository and runtime
tasks.objective: Detect framework, package manager, Node version, test setup, CI config, existing conventions and security-sensitive files; produce a repository map and a conventions note. No file may be modified.
acceptanceCriteria: Package manager and lockfile identified
Existing lint/type/test commands identified or explicitly marked missing
Sensitive files listed and excluded from cloud model context
No file is written during this task

tasks.title: Scaffold Next.js 15 + TypeScript + Tailwind workspace
tasks.objective: Create the monorepo skeleton with lint, format, typecheck and test scripts wired into CI on the agent branch.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm install succeeds inside the sandbox
pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck and pnpm test all exit 0 on the empty skeleton
CI workflow file added and valid YAML
forbiddenActions: enable network beyond the registry allowlist

tasks.title: Design Prisma schema for catalog, orders and inventory
tasks.objective: Define entities, relations, indexes and constraints, and generate a reversible migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Stock is constrained to be non-negative
Order total is stored in minor currency units
Migration has a working down path
Every table that holds tenant data carries organizationId
forbiddenActions: apply migration to any non-sandbox database

tasks.title: Implement session authentication and admin roles
tasks.objective: Add email+password and OAuth sign-in, session handling, role checks and authorization middleware.
acceptanceCriteria: Passwords are hashed with argon2id
Session cookies are httpOnly, secure and sameSite=lax
Admin-only routes reject non-admin callers in a test
No raw secret is ever logged

tasks.title: Implement catalog and inventory API
tasks.objective: Expose product, variant and stock endpoints with validation and tenant scoping.
acceptanceCriteria: All endpoints validate input at the boundary
Stock decrement is atomic under concurrent requests (test)
Pagination is bounded (max 100 per page)

tasks.title: Build the multilingual storefront UI
tasks.objective: Product listing, product detail, cart and checkout pages with fa-IR RTL support and full keyboard navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: fa-IR renders RTL with no layout overflow
Every interactive element is reachable by keyboard
Colour contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA (automated check)
Empty, loading and error states exist for each list

tasks.title: Integrate the payment provider behind an adapter
tasks.objective: Implement the PaymentProvider interface with a test-mode adapter and webhook signature verification.
acceptanceCriteria: No provider secret is read outside the adapter
Webhook signature is verified before any state change
A failed payment leaves the order in a consistent state (test)
Idempotency key prevents duplicate charges (test)

tasks.title: Assemble the QA matrix and run it
tasks.objective: Produce a test matrix covering happy paths, invalid input, authorization, i18n and accessibility, then execute it.
acceptanceCriteria: Every FR in the spec maps to at least one test
Flaky tests are reported separately, never silently retried into green
The report lists exact commands and exit codes
forbiddenActions: delete failing tests to make the suite pass

tasks.title: Run the security review gate
tasks.objective: Secret scan, dependency scan, static analysis and manual review of authz, SSRF, injection and tenant isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: Secret scan reports zero findings
No open critical or high finding remains
Every finding carries a verification command
forbiddenActions: mark a finding accepted-risk without a human approver

tasks.title: Containerise and publish a preview environment
tasks.objective: Dockerfile, health endpoint and a preview deployment behind an explicit approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Image builds with a non-root user and a read-only base layer
/health returns 200
Rollback command documented

tasks.title: Write delivery documentation and the final report
tasks.objective: README, environment variable list, migration and rollback instructions, plus the delivery report with evidence links.
acceptanceCriteria: Every required environment variable is documented with its purpose
Rollback steps are reproducible from the document alone
The delivery report links every claim to a log, diff or test result
forbiddenActions: claim success without an evidence link

requiredPermissions.purpose: Read the existing code before changing it
Create the agent branch and commit changes
Run checkout against the sandbox payment provider

risks.risk: The payment provider key is not available yet
risks.mitigation: Implement the adapter with a stub provider and gate live keys behind an approval.

risks.risk: Free-tier cloud model quota runs out mid-run
risks.mitigation: Model router falls back to the local model and pauses the run instead of failing silently.
Playwright visual + axe-core checks run on every frontend task.

rollbackStrategy: All work happens on the branch agent/plan_shop_mvp. Nothing is merged or deployed without approval. Rollback is 'git branch -D agent/plan_shop_mvp' plus dropping the preview environment; database migrations are reversible and were only applied inside the sandbox.

humanCheckpoints.reason: No write happens before this plan is approved.
Preview and production deployments are separate approvals.
